prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, channel mix, industry, and whether you need project work or an ongoing retainer.

To help me recommend a short list, tell me:
- What are your primary goals? (brand/creative, lead generation, paid ads, SEO, web/app build, social, PR, etc.)
- B2B or B2C?
- Approximate monthly/annual budget (or full project budget)?
- Preferred engagement: one-off project, monthly retainer, or performance-based?
- Any industries or competitors you want them to understand?

If you want a quick starting point, I can also pull a shortlist of highly regarded Kansas City agencies by specialty (creative, digital, performance, B2B) and include examples of their work, typical client sizes, and questions to ask during a discovery call. Which would you prefer?
